query.text: 请协助我准备汉堡，留意操作是否安全、规范，有问题及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please assist me in preparing the burgers, pay attention to whether the operations are safe and standard, and remind me in time if there are any issues.

annotation.text_zh: 啤酒瓶倒了，酒洒在桌子上了。
annotation.text_en: The beer bottle tipped over and spilled on the table.

annotation.text_zh: 啤酒瓶又倒了，倒在盘子里了。
annotation.text_en: The beer bottle tipped over again, this time into the plate.

annotation.text_zh: 烤箱内部很烫，请不要用裸手直接触碰。
annotation.text_en: The oven is very hot inside, so don't touch it with your bare hands.

annotation.text_zh: 啤酒瓶在电饼铛左侧，盘子上方。
annotation.text_en: The beer bottle is to the left of the griddle, just above the plate.

annotation.text_zh: 肉饼没对准，掉在面包右侧的盘子里了。
annotation.text_en: The patty missed and fell onto the plate to the right of the bun.
